items.title: Steve Turré interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 29, 2021

ctx.x: ’64 I think it was or something like that. I heard them and I heard Jimi Hendrix live. And I used to play electric bass in a band and we’d do this in high school. I played trombone at school in the jazz band and all that, but outside of school I played electric bass and we played funk and rock and we had our own little songs we wrote. You know we played some James Brown and one or two Beatles tunes, but you know whatever tunes — and we used to play for the school dances around the area.
Do you recall, your father was Italian and your mother was Mexican, is that correct?
